LIONEL MESSI BROUGHT the curtain down on his 21-year international career on Tuesday, bidding farewell to adoring Argentina fans in an emotional final appearance for the former world champions in Buenos Aires.

In a perfectly scripted finale, the 39-year-old widely regarded as the greatest football player in history signed off with his 126th international goal in front of 85,000 supporters as Argentina cruised to a 3-0 victory over Benin.

Lionel Messi signed off on his legendary international career. (Reuters: Rodrigo Valle)

Lionel Messi has played his final match for Argentina, scoring a penalty and setting up two other goals in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin.

Messi played his 208th international and scored his 126th goal for Argentina, both records, at the Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires.

After the game he told the crowd: "I love all of you, and I will miss all of you. I am proud to be Argentine."

Lionel Messi has delivered one last masterclass in blue and white as Argentina's captain brought the curtain down on his extraordinary 21-year international ​career by scoring a goal and setting up two others in a 3-0 friendly win over Benin.
